title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 5919 Chef Menteur Highway in New Orleans, Louisiana, as the "Daryle Holloway Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 5919 Chef Menteur Highway in New Orleans, Louisiana, as the "Daryle Holloway Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A 2016 law renamed a New Orleans post office building after Daryle Holloway.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a specific Postal Service building at 5919 Chef Menteur Highway in New Orleans, Louisiana, the official name "Daryle Holloway Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 13, 2016.
